courses.title: When Grief Comes Calling
courses.description: Recordings of a three-hour ritual workshop on grief with HeatherAsh Amara, Sarina Harz-Tolbert and Lara Rosenberg, as downloadable video and audio. It covers grief in its many forms, four elemental ritual practices drawn from Toltec and earth-based traditions, and gentle movement, breath and meditation for steadying the body.

left_out: Ancestral Fire: Connect to Your Beloved Dead and Tend Your Grief (Teotihuacán): the page now dates it 28 Oct to 3 Nov 2026, already past; the next annual date is not announced.
flags: When Grief Comes Calling: grief, collective trauma and nervous-system calm through ritual and somatic practice; one co-leader is a licensed clinical social worker and the page mentions 'somatic therapy' and a 'trauma-informed lens', but it is ritual and practice, not therapy, with no treatment claim. Kept under the new rule.
